content: Responsive SPA shell (verified MDN env() + viewport concepts): viewport-fit=cover opts into full-bleed layout and makes env(safe-area-inset-*) non-zero; apply safe-area-inset-bottom as extra padding on sticky bottom bars and action bars; 100vh equals the LARGE viewport so bottom content hides under mobile URL bars - use 100svh for must-be-visible shells and 100dvh for dynamic fill; layout viewport anchors fixed elements; desktop browser insets are 0 so desktop is unaffected.
